dct_description_sm:
Mapping depicts Brampton Plan-Schedule 1A Gateway transportation features. Gateways are prominent sites located at the entry points into the city, nodes and districts. They are visually prominent locations or are part of a landmark that may have historic importance.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
